thesis: The podcast argues that the U.S. electric grid faces a national emergency due to outdated technology, increasing outages, and volatile electricity prices driven by rising demand from AI, data centers, and electric vehicles. It explains that the grid is not a monolithic entity but consists of three major interconnections (East, Texas, and West) managed by regional transmission organizations (RTOs) and independent system operators (ISOs) to ensure reliability through balancing and market coordination.
